Experience the magic of 90s Bollywood romance with the timeless hit “Chura Ke Dil Mera”
Presented in stunning 4K quality, this iconic love song is from the classic film Main Khiladi Tu Anari, featuring the unforgettable on-screen chemistry of Akshay Kumar and Shilpa Shetty.
Beautifully sung by legendary voices Kumar Sanu and Alka Yagnik, this song remains one of the most loved romantic tracks of Indian cinema. Its soulful melody, memorable lyrics, and evergreen visuals continue to captivate audiences even today.
